summary: Regression testing for refactor (lib/documents.ts upsertDocument/upsertContractor, ContractorForm keyed remount, buildPrintHtml template helpers, SettingsView SellerCard/EmailCard applyForm, ItemsEditor ItemRowEditor) on Lechrol WZ SPA — all 7 focus areas PASS. Verified: (1) Editor save flow — new WZ defaults date=today, place='Łomianki'; validation toast 'Podaj nazwę odbiorcy.'; live number preview 8001/RA/2026 as contractor typed; save toast 'Zapisano dokument 8001/RA/2026.' and title flips to 'Edycja WZ 8001/RA/2026'; save-contractor checkbox created contractor (1 row in Kontrahenci). CRITICAL upsert-not-duplicate check: re-editing the same doc, changing email, re-checking 'save contractor' and saving — Kontrahenci table still shows exactly 1 row and localStorage confirms contractor email updated to 'updated@example.com' (upsertContractor uses form.contractorSel to locate existing). (2) Numbering — second doc same month got seq 2 with number 8002/AA/2026 (Alfa Beta -> A+A). (3) Items editor — added 3 rows (Row A/B/C) + empty row, removed first row: remaining rows kept values Row B and Row C in correct positions (stable rowId keys via ItemRowEditor). Empty rows filtered from persisted items on save. (4) Print preview — eye icon opens preview containing LECHROL, 'WZ — Wydanie zewnętrzne', Nr, Data, Miejsce, Sprzedawca, Odbiorca, table with Lp./Jedn./Ilość padded to 12 tbody rows, Uwagi, 'Wystawił' and 'Odebrał' signature blocks; close button works. (5) Kontrahenci — Edytuj on 'Rolety Siejka' opens form 'Edycja: Rolety Siejka' with prefilled name; without cancelling, clicking 'Dodaj kontrahenta' remounts to 'Nowy kontrahent' with EMPTY name (keyed remount via key={editingId||'new'} works — no stale values); validation toast 'Podaj nazwę kontrahenta.'; save toast 'Zapisano kontrahenta.'; search filters to 1 row; Kod column renders 'NT' for 'Nowy Klient' (first+last uppercase). (6) Settings applyForm round-trip — all seller/SMTP prefilled ('ZPHU Lechrol Jacek Wajcht'/'Łomianki'/'587'); changed place='Warszawa', smtp-port='465', email-subject='Nowy Temat'; save toast 'Zapisano ustawienia.'; after full page reload all three values persisted and new WZ default place = 'Warszawa'. (7) Regression — custom confirm modal for doc delete shows 'Usunąć dokument 8001/TA/2026? Tej operacji nie można cofnąć.', Anuluj keeps doc/count unchanged, Usuń deletes with toast 'Usunięto dokument …'; browser 'Wyślij e-mailem' shows toast 'Wysyłka e-mail dostępna tylko w aplikacji desktopowej.'; theme toggle light->dark persists across reload.
critical_code_review_comments: upsertContractor correctly picks existing contractor by form.contractorSel and Object.assigns updates — verified no duplicates on repeated save with checkbox; edge case handled well.
ContractorForm uses local useState from `initial` prop; parent passes key={editingId||'new'} so switching from Edytuj to Dodaj kontrahenta forces remount — verified empty form (no stale values leak).

collectItems filters rows where BOTH name and qty are empty (name OR qty keeps the row). This is intentional per prior iteration note; consider documenting or tightening to require name to avoid persisting qty-only rows.
structuredClone in upsertDocument ensures immutability of state — good.

buildPrintHtml helper split (headerHtml/metaHtml/partiesHtml/itemsTableHtml/footerHtml) keeps template modular; sanitizedPrintHtml via DOMPurify layered on top preserves the defense-in-depth confirmed in iteration 2.
SettingsView applyForm round-trip works correctly; SMTP port is treated as string in the form — fine since it's serialized to JSON, but consider Number() coercion on save for cleanliness.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 WZ docs and 2 contractors ('Rolety Siejka', 'Nowy Klient') in localStorage during testing; cleared between browser sessions. Settings were modified (place=Warszawa) — main agent may want to reset via localStorage.clear() if noticed in dev preview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav testids in Sidebar are nav-list / nav-contractors / nav-settings (NOT nav-docs). To return from Editor to docs list use [data-testid='back-btn'] or nav-list. localStorage key is 'lechrol-wz-data'. Stub window.print via add_init_script if print button tests are needed. Each new browser session starts with empty localStorage in this preview.
rca of the issue: No issues found — pure structural refactor preserved all behaviors.
